# dns (dns.origincloudapis.eu)

Guide: <https://docs.origincloud.eu/docs/dns/index.html.md>

- **HostedZoneService**: Hosted zones: the domains a project's records are answered for.
- **RecordSetService**: Record sets: every record of one name and type in a hosted zone.
- **VpcAttachmentService**: VPC attachments: the VPCs a private zone answers in.

## Packages

| Language | Install | Import |
|---|---|---|
| Rust | `cargo add origincloud-dns@0.25.0` | `origincloud_dns::v1beta1` |
| Go | `go get go.origincloud.eu/sdk@v0.27.0` | `go.origincloud.eu/sdk/dns/v1beta1` (package `dnsv1beta1`) |
| TypeScript | `npm install @origincloud/core@0.26.0 @origincloud/dns@0.26.0` | `@origincloud/dns/v1beta1` |

## Ask before

These delete something or can't be undone: show the user what will change and wait for their yes.

- `DeleteHostedZone`: deletes for good.
- `DeleteRecordSet`: deletes for good.
- `DeleteVpcAttachment`: deletes for good.

## HostedZoneService

Hosted zones: the domains a project's records are answered for.

| Language | Client |
|---|---|
| Rust | `HostedZoneClient::new(&client)` |
| Go | `dnsv1beta1.NewHostedZoneClient(client)` |
| TypeScript | `new HostedZoneClient(client)` |

| RPC | Rust | Go | TypeScript | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `GetHostedZone` (`GetHostedZoneRequest`) | `get_hosted_zone` | `GetHostedZone` | `getHostedZone` | Returns a hosted zone. requires `name` |
| `ListHostedZones` (`ListHostedZonesRequest`) | `list_hosted_zones`, `all_hosted_zones` | `ListHostedZones`, `AllHostedZones` | `listHostedZones`, `allHostedZones` | Lists a project's hosted zones, oldest first. requires `parent` |
| `CreateHostedZone` (`CreateHostedZoneRequest`) | `create_hosted_zone` | `CreateHostedZone` | `createHostedZone` | Creates a hosted zone, empty. a retry with the same `request_id` is safe; requires `parent`, `hosted_zone` |
| `UpdateHostedZone` (`UpdateHostedZoneRequest`) | `update_hosted_zone` | `UpdateHostedZone` | `updateHostedZone` | Changes a hosted zone's tags. a retry with the same `request_id` is safe; requires `hosted_zone`, `update_mask` |
| `DeleteHostedZone` (`DeleteHostedZoneRequest`) | `delete_hosted_zone` | `DeleteHostedZone` | `deleteHostedZone` | Deletes a hosted zone. **ask first**: deletes for good; a retry with the same `request_id` is safe; requires `name` |
| `VerifyHostedZone` (`VerifyHostedZoneRequest`) | `verify_hosted_zone` | `VerifyHostedZone` | `verifyHostedZone` | Checks a public zone's challenge now, instead of waiting for the platform's next check, and returns the zone as it is then, with the check's outcome in `challenge.last_check`. requires `name` |

## RecordSetService

Record sets: every record of one name and type in a hosted zone.

|---|---|

## Resources

### HostedZone

A domain a project's records are answered for.

- Full name: `//dns.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/hostedZones/{hosted_zone}`
- `name`: `projects/{project}/hostedZones/{hosted_zone}`

| Field (JSON) | Type | Behavior | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | identifier | The zone's resource name. |
| `urn` | string | output only | The zone's URN, the identifier access policies and the audit log use. |
| `dnsName` | string | required, immutable | The domain, such as `example.com`, without the final dot; answered in lowercase. |
| `visibility` | HostedZone.Visibility | required, immutable | Where the zone is answered. One of `PUBLIC`, `PRIVATE`. |
| `state` | HostedZone.State | output only | Whether the zone is answered. One of `PENDING_VERIFICATION`, `ACTIVE`, `SUSPENDED`. |
| `nameServers` | repeated string | output only | The name servers to delegate a public zone to at its registrar, as NS records of its name. |
| `challenge` | OwnershipChallenge | output only | How a public zone proves control of its name, and how it went. |
| `createTime` | timestamp | output only | When the zone was created. |
| `creator` | string | output only | The principal that created the zone, such as `user:<id>` or `service_account:<id>`. |
| `tags` | map<string, string> | optional | Labels of your own, at most 50. |

### RecordSet

Every record of one name and type in a hosted zone.

- Full name: `//dns.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/hostedZones/{hosted_zone}/recordSets/{record_set}`
- `name`: `projects/{project}/hostedZones/{hosted_zone}/recordSets/{record_set}`

| Field (JSON) | Type | Behavior | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | identifier | The record set's resource name. |
| `urn` | string | output only | The record set's URN, the identifier access policies and the audit log use. |
| `dnsName` | string | required, immutable | The name the records answer for: the zone's `dns_name` or a name below it, written in full, such as `www.example.com`, without the final dot; answered in lowercase. |
| `type` | RecordSet.Type | required, immutable | The records' type. One of `A`, `AAAA`, `CNAME`, `TXT`, `MX`, `SRV`, `CAA`. |
| `ttl` | duration | optional | How long resolvers may keep the answer, from 30 seconds to 7 days, in whole seconds. |
| `basic` | BasicRecordData | required | Values of its own. One of the oneof `data`. |
| `alias` | AliasRecordData | required | The address of a platform resource, followed as it changes. One of the oneof `data`. |
| `createTime` | timestamp | output only | When the record set was created. |
| `updateTime` | timestamp | output only | When the record set was last changed. |

### VpcAttachment

A VPC a private zone answers in.

- Full name: `//dns.origincloudapis.eu/projects/{project}/hostedZones/{hosted_zone}/vpcAttachments/{vpc_attachment}`
- `name`: `projects/{project}/hostedZones/{hosted_zone}/vpcAttachments/{vpc_attachment}`

| Field (JSON) | Type | Behavior | About |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | identifier | The attachment's resource name. |
| `urn` | string | output only | The attachment's URN, the identifier access policies and the audit log use. |
| `vpc` | string | required, immutable | The VPC the zone answers in, in the zone's project. Names a `Vpc`. |
| `createTime` | timestamp | output only | When the zone was attached. |
